newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell Nigeria announces three new appointments.
newsitem.headline: Shell Nigeria announces three new appointments.

text.p: Royal Dutch Shell's Nigerian unit has announced the appointment of three senior management staff effective from March 23, the state news agency reported on Thursday.
The agency, quoting a company statement, said Egbert Imomoh was named the new deputy managing director to replace Godwin Omene who had retired.
British national Chris Haynes takes over from Imomoh as head of the operations in the eastern division while Joshua Udofa replaces Haynes, former head of the western division.
Shell, one of six multinationals operating in Nigeria, pumps about half the country's two million barrels per day of crude oil.
